title: Updating the Accepting-Runs Register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $7$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting its accepting-runs field to $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 7 equal to its accepting-runs field. Replacing coordinate 7 of
this vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing
its accepting-runs field by $y$.
